title: Republicans Want To Lose The Midterms. We Shouldn’t Let Them
text:
(Photo by Andrew Harnik/Getty Images)

Americans are witnessing the Republican Party seemingly trying to lose the midterm elections, which would result in Democrats taking control of Congress. Voters really only have one option to make them pay for betraying their base: ensure they win.

The Trump administration is on a string of successful immigration policies that will help the next generation of Americans looking for access to the American Dream. A recent Center for Immigration Studies (CIS) report analyzing the Census Bureau’s monthly Current Population Survey (CPS) is probably the single most important indicator of President Donald Trump’s second-term success. It found that the U.S. foreign-born population declined by 2.9 million between January 2025 and July 2026. CIS treats this reversal as evidence that net migration turned negative for the first time since the 1930s.
